posts.text: Denne (fra Fearnley ) ble delt på xtrainvestor:  Petrobras denies Subsea 7’s appeal, upholds PLSV award to Seagems Petrobras has denied Subsea 7's appeal against the award in Lot C1-BB in PLSV tender for the Seagems Neptune, upholding the original result. The Committee found no violation of the confidentiality in the closed bidding process. Moreover, the Committee did not find that the price presented in the foreign-flag lot C2-EE was used as a parameter for the negotiation in lot C1-BB. The reduction in dayrates compared to the initial bid resulted from the negotiation stage in the tender. Regarding the discrepancy in the diesel price, the error was regarded as correctable and would not gain the winning bidder any economic advantage. As such, the Committee has denied Subsea 7’s requests and has fully upheld the decision that declared the Seagems Neptune as qualified and as the winner of Lot C1-BB. The appeal phase for Lot C has subsequently been closed.
